question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you want Paige and Owen to get together?
Does your school have a winter dance?

nodes.text: $ZOE lunges for her posters, catching each and every one before they hit the ground!
She carefully stacks them into a pile...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! They're all unharmed!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm introducing $ZOE here to all the different cliques as the new Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I did have something to say about the Snow Ball...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ooh! When's the dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That hasn't been decided.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just don't plan anything on the first Saturday in December. We signed up for an Ogres 'N' Elves tournament that day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, of course! But it'd be a real help if you came to the planning meeting to remind me. Can you guys come after school for that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If his character is selfish and greedy, then he's playing the role.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't that the point of role-playing? To stay in character?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: See? She gets it. And that means the gold is mine!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Now look what you've done...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If he's in-character, then so are you. You can negotiate with him, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Not exactly...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Andronicus negotiates with no one!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Not so fast. Kevincular won't stand for such treachery! To arms!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, you don't have to fight!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: To arms!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't what I thought would happen...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, at least `one person` is happy...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, at least [color=#3b78e2][i]one person[/i][/color] is happy...

nodes.text: Taylor points to Andrew who is laughing in his friends' faces.
As Ashley moderates the fight between Kevin and Andrew, the rest turn to Taylor and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I hope you weren't here for anything important.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I admire your ability to remain in-character...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there is such a thing as taking it too far. And you're taking it to the point that it's ruining the game for others.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And the defense rests.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I suppose Andronicus can `drop` some of his gold for the others.
nodes.text_bbcode: I suppose Andronicus can [color=#e23b3b][i]drop[/i][/color] some of his gold for the others.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay! Gold!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice save, Social Chair.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You are most definitely `not welcome.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You are most definitely [color=#e23b3b][i]not welcome.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, not everyone can be happy. You did good.
As Andrew grumbles over what a fair share of gold looks like, the others turn to Taylor and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So are you here for something else or did you just want to see us play?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That could have gone better...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I didn't realize telling Autumn to do whatever she wanted would cause such trouble.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, you kind of broke Autumn's heart there. But it's probably a good lesson about not pleasing everyone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You really have to watch what you say now. You have some weight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why can't Autumn do her own thing with the yearbook pictures?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So now that that's settled... Can we help you with anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, actually. The Snow Ball is coming up soon, and I wanted to get your input.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: When is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that hasn't really been decided. In fact, I want it to be up to everyone at the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's going to be on a Friday or Saturday either the first or second week of December.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hmmm... The journalism club is getting some of its photos in the local art gallery in town on the second Friday, so the dance shouldn't be on that day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The `second Friday`? Okay, I won't schedule it that day.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]second Friday[/i][/color]? Okay, I won't schedule it that day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But in the mean time, there's a meeting after school today to discuss details. Can you guys make it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Of course you'd say that. You're practically student gov. You have to say what the administration is going to say.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, that's my opinion. I think the student pictures should stay the same.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Otherwise, it'll confuse people, and if no one understands what you're trying to do, then your message isn't going to get heard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can you make a statement if it doesn't speak to people?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you can't put your pictures in other places in the yearbook.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, if we put your photos on other pages, we can scale them bigger.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I kind of liked them smaller, but I guess that's fine.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great. Thanks for your input, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I agree.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just glad it all worked out.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's your yearbook, and you should get to do whatever you want.
Taylor makes a strangled noise in her throat.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? I like the expressive prints, but I feel traditional is the way to go.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: If anything, we won't get yelled at by the administration.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: $ZOE's right, though. It's our project. We should get to make our own choices.
Taylor elbows into the circle.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, I hate to step in. Autumn, your prints are great, but we really should go in a more traditional direction.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But $ZOE said...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE is only the Social Chair. She's not really making calls about the yearbook. And we need to follow the administration's rules. Sorry, Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All right...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm trying to warn you, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In a perfect world, everything would fall into place.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But it's not perfect.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You have to learn that you can't please everybody.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, until that happens... I can always hope for the best.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sigh. All right. Let's get this over with.
In a classroom, $ZOE and Taylor find the journalism club.
Denni and Autumn pore over photos, while Colt sits in a corner, his feet propped up on a desk.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The photos you've taken of everyone are amazing, Autumn! It's like you captured their soul.
Denni picks up a flattering picture of Colt riding his motorcycle onto campus.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, you look so peaceful here...
Colt leans over to see.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What is my face doing in that picture? I'm not complaining, but I've never made a face like that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You have when you're riding your motorcycle. And I think you look nice.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: At last she captured my ruggedly handsome side.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: As opposed to?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My devilishly handsome side. I like it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks! I was thinking for the yearbook that we should replace the traditional photos with these.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: These feel so much more compelling.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... I really do appreciate your artistic vision, Autumn, but... I'm not so sure about replacing the photos.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: People are going to be expecting the traditional layout.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Should we always put in what people expect?
Taylor clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey guys... This is official school business. I'm introducing the new Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure everyone knows $ZOE by now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's ceremony.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, that's great. You know I voted for you. The work you did on that haunted house was inspired! It was like living art!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, but it wasn't all me. I had a lot of help.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hey, since you're a ranked official and all, can I take your picture?
Before $ZOE can say anything, Autumn has picked up her camera and taken a few shots. She studies them.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Cute. Looking at these pictures of you makes me wistful and filled with longing. These will be perfect for the layout!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The layout?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We're working on the layout design for the yearbook.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Autumn just printed out some pictures. We're looking them over.
Denni lays out the photos for $ZOE. Autumn's candid shots seem to make each student come alive.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I like them... But seriously, does everyone stare off into the distance like that? And where's all the color?
Denni nudges him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think these look great! Autumn, you did these?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah! My new camera makes it easier to capture movement.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But we have a small problem...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Autumn's pictures weren't exactly what the school had in mind for the student portraits. They're a little `too` expressive.
nodes.text_bbcode: Autumn's pictures weren't exactly what the school had in mind for the student portraits. They're a little [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] expressive.

nodes.text: Denni holds up another assortment of pictures. $ZOE sees they are standard profile shots.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: The school wants us to go with these.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, they're nice.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, but they're not particularly unique. I really want to do something different with the yearbook this year.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Something that really captures people and tells them they're special.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I see what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do you think? Which ones would you go with?
$ZOE opens her mouth to answer when she sees Taylor giving her a look.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have no idea what she wants me to say...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You should go with the...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like you said, they voted for me. Now I have to listen to them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, look who let power go straight to her head!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not that. It's just... How am I supposed to make anyone happy if I don't ask?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Your cheerfulness is kind of gross...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I guess I know what you're getting at.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh-huh... That's what I thought.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, you're awfully `sweet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, $ZOE, you're awfully [color=#3b78e2][i]sweet.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I remember you saying that a few seconds ago...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But people want different things. The more suggestions you get, the harder a time you'll have when it comes to making decisions.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Trust me, I have to ignore everyone else's opinions all the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that what you're supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! People voted for me so I can think for them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I don't know?
$ZOE lunges for all her posters, but she catches none of them.
They flutter around her like snowflakes in winter, landing gently on the ground where others in the hallways step and tromp on them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I made all of those by hand...
She salvages some of her posters and stands up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Honestly, I don't even want to talk about it anymore. I've gotten over him once. I can do it again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I plan to do that by being incredibly busy. Which is why I'm doing all this!
$ZOE gestures to a flyer she's just taped up. The paper reads 'Snow Ball Dance Committee'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been meaning to ask you... What's up with this dance committee?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As the new `Social Chair`, I want to ask everyone's opinion on the theme and decorations for the winter dance!
nodes.text_bbcode: As the new [color=#3b78e2][i]Social Chair[/i][/color], I want to ask everyone's opinion on the theme and decorations for the winter dance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what better way to do that than to have a meeting?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate to burst your optimistic happy bubble, but will people show up? It's a meeting after all.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm bringing a whole bunch of snacks that I got a local deli to donate to our school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Paige's carnival taught me anything, it's that people are really attracted to food...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And speaking of dances...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are you going to the Snow Ball with?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't like my plan to tag along with whatever sap you're taking to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course you can come with me, but maybe you'd like to go on a `date.` Maybe there's a guy you like...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course you can come with me, but maybe you'd like to go on a [color=#3b78e2][i]date.[/i][/color] Maybe there's a guy you like...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to stop you right there... Who do you think I would even bring? There are only so many single guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He has a weird thing going on with Maria. I'm not about to touch that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phil?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's too... Stubbly.
$ZOE and Sam stop in front of the computer lab. $ZOE holds up another flyer to the wall, and Sam struggles to give her more tape.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm done with the rebel bad-boy, thank you very much.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Keith?
Sam makes a face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or Nate?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can we get off guys who'd rather be dating you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good point. Wes?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't trust that guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about Erik? You guys seemed to get along during that Father's Day project.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik is a great guy, but he's a `little` weird.
nodes.text_bbcode: Erik is a great guy, but he's a [color=#3b78e2][i]little[/i][/color] weird.

nodes.text: $ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then who?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's exactly my point! Now maybe we can move away from--
Sam's words are cut off as the doors to the photo lab swing open into her, knocking her backwards!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Make way! Coming through! I'm going to be late!
Dex rushes by! Sam tries to grab for anything, but accidentally clips $ZOE's hand!
$ZOE's flyers are tossed into the air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and I had a connection, and whenever I was with him, it felt really right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But even though we're compatible and we love each other, our goals right now aren't the same.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sounds like a hard lesson to learn.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's what my heart tells me every day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That wasn't `life just happening`, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: That wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]life just happening[/i][/color], $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was Howard being homesick and confused and taking advantage of how much you cared about him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You were doing fine without him, and then he comes out of nowhere, and you two get back together again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right. Fine. Maybe he did stir things up again by coming back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But he's gone now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's probably for the best. Now I can really move on.

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
Before class, $ZOE and Sam are putting flyers up in the halls.
$ZOE takes down a poster advertising 'Basketball Tryouts' and puts up a poster of her own.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Down with the old... In with the new... La tee da... {
Sam hands $ZOE some pieces of tape she's torn off from a roll.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's way too early in the mornng for you to be this happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I was humming too much again, wasn't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't be sorry. It's a good thing. It's nice to see you so chipper. I haven't see you happy since...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, since Howard left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe he broke up with you again! The nerve of that guy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd strangle him, if I could.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not angry. And you don't have to be either. When Howard and I broke up, I learned that sometimes...

nodes.text: $ZOE sprints through the exit doors and into the hallway! There, she catches her breath, panting hard.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...
The cafeteria doors suddenly open, and $ZOE looks up, ready for anything...
But it's just Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad you made it out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You too...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't realize this would be so hard. Everyone was `so` angry...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't realize this would be so hard. Everyone was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] angry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. You should see budget meetings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What am I going to do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're just going to have to make it work.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Find a day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, there `is` no day... Or at least not one that works for everyone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor, there [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] no day... Or at least not one that works for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No. And that's what I've been trying to say!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, you were voted into Social Chair so `you` could plan events. I can guide you, but stuff like this is up to you.
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, you were voted into Social Chair so [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] could plan events. I can guide you, but stuff like this is up to you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And the hard thing about politics is that, even though you try your best...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `Someone's` going to get let down.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Someone's[/i][/color] going to get let down.

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 2, The Dance Dilemma, Part 1!`

nodes.text: But $ZOE gets pelted in the face and chest!
She stands there stunned as more food flies in her direction.
In a matter of moments, she's covered from head to foot in yogurt, chocolate pudding, and soda.
She doesn't know if she should shout or run... And that's when the doors to the cafeteria burst open and Mr. Dean steps in.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: `Stop this at once!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Stop this at once![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: `What's going on here?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What's going on here?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone puts down the food item they're holding, and no one moves.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: `Who started this mess?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Who started this mess?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Slowly and conclusively, everyone shifts their gaze to $ZOE, covered in food.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, sir... I was trying to plan the dance, and things spiraled out of control...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: So it is your doing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're going to come with me.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: We're going to have a talk with the `principal.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're going to have a talk with the [color=#e23b3b][i]principal.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: As $ZOE is herded out the doors, she knows in her heart that...
She has failed.

$ZOE...

$ZOE sprints forward, evading it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah!
Just up ahead, $ZOE sees the nerds catapult a flurry of meatballs!
$ZOE freezes!
Her hesitation costs her. She sees the soda shoot one foamy arc in her direction. She tries to twist away...
$ZOE freezes!
Her hesitation costs her. She sees the soda shoot one foamy arc in her direction. She tries to twist away...
$ZOE dives under the table, as soda spritzes through the air, spraying everyone in the blast radius with sticky, sugary syrup.
$ZOE throws the tray up in time, deflecting the yogurt cup.
$ZOE grabs the spoon and tries to defend herself...
Before $ZOE can do anything, Megan takes the banana she's been eating and throws it at Maria's face!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You... You!
Maria throws her fruit cup at Megan, strawberries spraying everywhere...
And the cafeteria explodes into chaos!
All around $ZOE, food starts flying everywhere! A fruit cup hits Erik in the face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: May day! May day! Pilot down!
Erik falls to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!
Beside $ZOE, Taylor has her hands up, covering her face. A few feet away, one of the rebels aims a chocolate cup in her direction...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, watch--
Suddenly Justin leaps out of the crowd, running for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Assassination attempt!
Justin jumps in front of Taylor, the pudding cup hitting him in the chest. He lays on the ground panting.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Madame President... Save yourself...

nodes.text: So, you're totally going to let us plan the dances with you, right?

nodes.text: We're way interested in going to your meeting. I have some opinions on the dance theme.

nodes.text: You might want to be careful what you promise.

nodes.text: Are you worried I'm...
And that's when she remembers Sam. She looks over and sees Nick pulling Sam to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Careful there. Apparently the hallways are a dangerous place.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Apparently.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't stand in front of swinging doors.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It does seem like a dangerous habit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You could say that.
They stand that way for a moment longer, then Sam abruptly pulls back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, nice catch, Nick! But I have to help $ZOE with her things. Bye!
Sam takes $ZOE's arm and walks quickly down the hall with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You two looked awfully comfortable. What was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `That` was nothing. He was just being nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was nothing. He was just being nice.

nodes.text: $ZOE stops Sam next to another bulletin board and finishes putting the remaining posters up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh. You know... `Nick` is single, or so I've heard.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh. You know... [color=#3b78e2][i]Nick[/i][/color] is single, or so I've heard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been on that roller coaster ride, and I'm not standing in line again.

nodes.text: Even if I've forgiven him, there's still that big elephant in the room that we're not talking about.

nodes.text: Elephant in the room?

nodes.text: `Sara.` It just... Wouldn't be right. He loved her. There hasn't been enough time for him to get over her.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara.[/i][/color] It just... Wouldn't be right. He loved her. There hasn't been enough time for him to get over her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And like I told you, I don't want to be `second`, especially to someone who... You know.
nodes.text_bbcode: And like I told you, I don't want to be [color=#3b78e2][i]second[/i][/color], especially to someone who... You know.

nodes.text: Nick and I will never get together.

nodes.text: That may be true, but that doesn't mean you can't go to the dance as friends.

nodes.text: I don't think he's interested in me anymore. I saw him the other night... With Paige.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What were they doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, but they seem really close. And Owen said something about `what happened the other night.` What does that mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, but they seem really close. And Owen said something about [color=#3b78e2][i]what happened the other night.[/i][/color] What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So? That could mean anything. It could be a school project they're working on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I'm sure Paige cares about `school.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I'm sure Paige cares about [color=#3b78e2][i]school.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe he ran into her car in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just saying... You don't know the entire story. It might not be what you think.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Paige and Owen hate each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Do` they?

nodes.text: That's Taylor... She wants to see me. I should go. But thanks for coming with me to put the posters up.

nodes.text: All right. I'll see you after school. We can talk about Owen later.

nodes.text: Hey, Ms. President. What did you need me for?

nodes.text: It's time to take your powers for a spin. I'm taking you out to introduce you to all the cliques.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh great, I just bored myself talking. I've been hanging around Justin way too long.

nodes.text: But you get what I mean, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... School limitations. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, let's move. We have a whole bunch of cliques to get through, and first period's coming up soon!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Andrew's character, Andronicus, attacks and vanquishes the hideous dragon! As the dragon fades away, they free the mystical Pandas of Pandaton!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: For their bravery, the pandas reward the adventurers by showing them a stack of gold. The adventurers rush forward to claim it--

nodes.text: What is the meaning of this, Andronicus?

nodes.text: You can't keep all the gold for yourself... That's tyranny!

nodes.text: I can tell you who else doesn't approve... Everyone who helped you slay the dragon!

nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, Taylor. But... You haven't been coming lately, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] wanted to play...

nodes.text: Until Andrew here stole our moment of glory!

nodes.text: What is Andrew doing now?

nodes.speaker: Andrew

nodes.text_bbcode: You are not speaking to Andrew. You are speaking to [color=#e23b3b][i]Andronicus the Great![/i][/color] The slayer of dragons! The king of men!

nodes.text: He conquered an island of two people, and the power's gone straight to his head...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Andronicus the Great is not gentle or rational. He is chaotic and prone to bouts of narcissism!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And it is his right to take the gold as the true hero.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't quite get what's going on here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Andrew made the killing blow on the evil dragon, and he feels he's entitled to all the gold.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `I` don't feel entitled. `Andronicus the Great` feels entitled.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] don't feel entitled. [color=#e23b3b][i]Andronicus the Great[/i][/color] feels entitled.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how is that any different?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm `me`, and Andronicus is `my character.` When we first started this mission, I created a vain, selfish personality profile for Andronicus.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color], and Andronicus is [color=#e23b3b][i]my character.[/i][/color] When we first started this mission, I created a vain, selfish personality profile for Andronicus.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And he's exactly the type of person who'd betray you all for a mountain of riches...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Enough of that! You only killed the beast because we helped you weaken the monster! You wouldn't be 'the Great' anything without us!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah! If you think this party is letting you take all the gold after all the resources we've put into it, then you've got another thing coming.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, we don't have to go there. Can't you guys just settle it amicably? Andrew, share the gold.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `I` would love to, but my other self would have to endure a life-changing catalyst and several years of the love of a beautiful elf maiden before he'd ever entrust anyone else with the loot!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] would love to, but my other self would have to endure a life-changing catalyst and several years of the love of a beautiful elf maiden before he'd ever entrust anyone else with the loot!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And it's easy for you to say 'Share', but how does Andronicus know that the ranger, `Taylor the Swift` isn't just encouraging the sharing of wealth, so she can profit from a timely trade with Brendanimal?
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's easy for you to say 'Share', but how does Andronicus know that the ranger, [color=#e23b3b][i]Taylor the Swift[/i][/color] isn't just encouraging the sharing of wealth, so she can profit from a timely trade with Brendanimal?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I would never--I mean, `Taylor the Swift` would never do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I would never--I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor the Swift[/i][/color] would never do that!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's a perfectly rational way to settle this. $ZOE, you're the only person with no vested interest. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Andrew is...
She whirls around, looking around for the exit, when she sees Hannah shaking up two cans of soda in each hand.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Drink this, nerds!
$ZOE realizes she's in the way and...
When it's over, $ZOE scrambles from underneath the length of the table and sets her eyes on the exit door...
The only thing blocking her way to the exit is the exchange of meatballs thrown between the nerds and the journalism club...
She sees the rhythm of the volleys and starts running through!
In the corner of her eye, she sees a couple meatballs fly in her direction!
And the cafeteria explodes into chaos!
All around $ZOE, food starts flying everywhere! A fruit cup hits Erik in the face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: May day! May day! Pilot down!
Erik falls to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!
Beside $ZOE, Taylor has her hands up, covering her face. A few feet away, one of the rebels aims a chocolate cup in her direction...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, watch--
Suddenly Justin leaps out of the crowd, running for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Assassination attempt!
Justin jumps in front of Taylor, the pudding cup hitting him in the chest. He lays on the ground panting.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Madame President... Save yourself...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Justin... You will be avenged. If I get out of here untouched!
Taylor rolls to the side, just in time to avoid globs of chocolate pudding.
$ZOE realizes she's left in the open! A volley of yogurt cups heads in her direction!
She looks around and frantically grabs for...
